newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore shares end lower, City Developments down.
newsitem.headline: Singapore shares end lower, City Developments down.

text.p: Singapore shares ended mostly weaker on Wednesday with property stocks, led by bluechip City Developments Ltd (CityDev), seeing sharp declines.

Dealers said CityDev came under more selling pressure on talk the stock was over-valued given the soft property market. It closed 40 cents lower at Singapore $13.40. DBS Land and Singapore Land also ended lower, by 25 cents and 20 cents respectively at S$5.35 and S$7.80.
Index stock Keppel Corp also closed at its year low of S$10, down 10 cents, with almost two million changing hands. "The stock is going to underperform the market," said a local broker.

Keppel posted lower 1996 profit and also proposed a bonus issue on Tuesday. Its off-shore rigbuilding unit Keppel FELS continued to slide in active trade after warning of lower 1997 profits. It closed off the day's low at S$4.88, down 27 cents.
The Straits Times Industrial index ended down 17.36 points at 2,177.39. Total market volume was 221.37 million units with 299 losers outstripping 89 gainers.

Topping the actives list was Omni Industries with 15 million traded. It ended up 3.5 cents at S$0.785. Dealers said there was short covering ahead of the counter trading on a "ready" basis later in the week. - Doreen Siow 65-8703092 REUTER
